title: Complete reusable evidence catalogs and independent receipt sections
description: Bring controlled evidence catalogs to compatibility with existing dynamic source catalogs, and expose customer-level unlinked receipt evidence as an independent bounded section usable by generic bundles. Apply to shipment-finance and receipt-reconciliation together; reuse original SalesOrderProgress, SalesOrderShipmentFinanceReport and SalesOrderReceiptReconciliation helpers, no copied algorithms. Stage 2 only. Preserve every existing route until ALL fixed/dynamic migrations have actual data, permission and Excel/PDF compatibility. No dedicated report controller/designer/exporter, arbitrary SQL/identifiers/joins, production operations, schema/seed/migration changes, secrets/env changes or permission expansion. Keep existing Domain/Application/Infrastructure/Api layering. Real writes in tests only after guard (localdb)\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance and NEWERP_AUTOTEST_*; missing legacy schema/browser acceptance is an accurate environment blocker, not passed parity.
acceptance_criteria: Compare every legacy catalog field in DynamicShipmentFinanceReportRules and DynamicReceiptReconciliationReportRules with the controlled providers; restore missing allocation, invoice, known/unknown, label/note/count and truncation fields with original keys/types/null and currency semantics. Preserve generic selected column validation and presets, never invent replacement calculations.

Expose a finite independent unlinked-receipt dataset section using original SalesOrderReceiptReconciliation.ForQueryAsync result for the SAME bounded scoped order-page customers/filter set. Preserve separate receipt grain, original currency, source truncation, reference and no-order-attribution semantics; never join receipt amounts into order totals or infer allocation. Revalidate sales-order menu, current-user scope and finite field/filter bounds on every request; API-level provider registration avoids Infrastructure depending on Api.

Enable generic bundle sections to carry matching finite source-page filters without hidden joins; all sections validate first and fail together on denied/revoked fields/menu/scope. Compare complete field catalogs and source-helper rows, separate empty/nonempty receipt sections, unknown values and truncated evidence in focused unit fixtures and generic Excel/PDF; safe Release build/unit suite and contracts pass. Actual browser/SQL/output parity remains unverified until real proof; keep old routes.
implementation_evidence: Live API acceptance evidence .ai/logs/ERP-303-runtime-api-acceptance-20261005 proves 2 admin rows and recipient42 scoped row, but generic receipt preset omits numerous legacy allocation/invoice/coverage fields and legacy receiptRows section. ReceiptReconciliationReportConfigurationDatasetProvider.cs only maps selected reduced fields from report.Groups and drops unlinked receipt result. Shipment provider also requires full catalog comparison; ERP307 only bundles existing definitions, no evidence completeness/independent receipt adapter.
